name: rosalind
description: A workbench for guided life-science workflows in ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: A workspace connecting scientific tools for sequencing analysis, evidence synthesis, protein and small-molecule design, structure and sequence analysis, safety and developability, experimental validation, and GPT-Rosalind access.
defaultPrompt: Build a research workspace with Life Sciences Literature.
Run FastQC with NGS Analysis Workbench.
Open and visualize a PDB structure.
